signal: /wai-brief command: outbound context export for external AI sessions. Topic mode gathers evidence from lugs+track+state and outputs: background, current state, options in play (only from record — never invented), open questions, blank 'What I Need From You'. Completes the outbound/inbound pair with /wai-chat-to-track.
rationale: Phone-a-friend capability. Any project can now export a self-contained context block for external AI consultation without manual copy/paste of state.
